comment_regular: Authoritative Oblivion SCPT runtime loader. Stream-replays every chunk: SCHR and SCDA mutate singleton fields (later chunks win); SLSD and SCRO/SCRV append; SCVR names only the latest SLSD created during this call. Unlike TESCS, Oblivion has no SCTX handler. SCHD is also absent.
